instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, model views, properties, families already available in the project, and built-in IFC export commands. Roofed cafe pavilion. Start from a blank Revit project. Model a one-storey cafe pavilion with an overall footprint about 12 m by 8 m. Create three named rooms: Seating, Service, and Kitchen. Use exterior walls, one interior partition layout, one floor slab, one simple roof over the footprint, at least three doors, and at least three windows. Create real Revit model elements rather than visual-only detail lines or placeholder geometry. Use the Revit Room tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Revit's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 or IFC2x3 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Seating, Service, Kitchen; at least 1 building storeys, at least 6 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 1 roofs, at least 3 doors, at least 3 windows; no IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. The overall model extents should be about 12 m by 8 m horizontally and about 3.4 m tall, with ordinary Revit modeling tolerance. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, relationship nesting, and harmless metadata may vary.
